snippet.title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes is available NOW on Steam and GOG: https://bsgscatteredhopes.com/

Escape the Fall of the Twelve Colonies, and take command of a fleet of survivors relentlessly chased by the Cylon Fleet in their attempt to rejoin Humanity’s last hope: the Battlestar Galactica.

Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes is a survival fleet-management roguelite combining procedural narrative design with real-time tactical space combat.

Shoulder the heavy burden of leadership as you make critical decisions for your fleet’s survival under constant pressure:
- Dispatch expeditions to gather critical resources
- Manage crises, politics, and morale across your fleet
- Upgrade ships and train crew for the battles ahead
- Command squadrons and unleash powerful Gunstar attacks in real time
- Use Tactical Pause to plan and adapt under pressure

Your decisions will shape the fate of the fleet. Prepare, fight, and survive at all costs.

In addition to today’s launch, we also released an updated and improved demo, with progress carrying from our previous demo release. 
To make sure your efforts aren’t wasted, all demo progress will carry over to the full game – try it now!

Stay updated and join the Fleet’s HQ on social media: 
💫 X - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes : https://x.com/playbsg 
💫 Facebook - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes : https://www.facebook.com/playbsg 
💫 Reddit - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes : https://www.reddit.com/r/playbsg/ 
💫 Discord - Alt Shift : https://discordapp.com/invite/jgdQ7XY
